title: uv lock JSONL (preview)
description: A single record in a command's preview JSONL stream.

code.description: A machine-readable classification of the failure.

http_status.description: The HTTP status code, when the failure came from an HTTP response.

message.description: A fixed description that does not include unparsed input or source text.

package.description: The affected package, when it can be identified.

JsonlProgressEvent.title: uv JSONL progress (preview)
JsonlProgressEvent.description:
A progress update emitted before a command's final JSONL result.

Concurrent operations are correlated using their process-wide `id`. Top-level
phases omit `id`, since only one instance of each phase is active at a time.
Operations can complete without an intermediate update.

completed.description: Completed bytes for transfers, or completed packages for package phases.

id.description: A process-wide identifier shared by all events for one concurrent operation.

name.description: The package, distribution, or source currently being processed.

phase.description: The operation being reported, such as `download`, `build`, or `install`.

revision.description: The Git revision associated with a checkout operation.

total.description: The fixed total bytes or packages for this operation, when known.

type.description: Distinguishes progress updates from the final command result.

url.description: The source URL associated with a resolution or checkout operation.

version.description: The selected package version, when available.

JsonlResult.title: uv lock (preview)
JsonlResult.description: An object-valued command result with the JSONL discriminator.

action.description: The lockfile action; create and update are proposed actions in a dry run.

dry_run.description: Whether the operation reports proposed changes without writing the lockfile.

error.description: The error that prevented the operation from completing.

path.description: The lockfile path, once the project or script has been discovered.

reason.description: Why the previous lock could not be reused, if known.

status.description: The lockfile's freshness after the operation.

type.description: Distinguishes the final command result from progress updates.

validation_error.description: A failed check of the previous lock, even if a later resolution also fails.

actual.description: The values recorded in the existing lockfile.

code.description: The mismatch that prevents reuse of the previous lock.

expected.description: The values required by the current inputs.

package.description: The affected package, when the mismatch is package-specific.

PackageName.description:
The normalized name of a package.

Converts the name to lowercase and collapses runs of `-`, `_`, and `.` down to a single `-`.
For example, `---`, `.`, and `__` are all converted to a single `-`.

See: <https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/name-normalization/>

ProgressPhase.description: An operation reported by the preview JSONL interface.

ProgressStatus.description: The lifecycle of an operation: started, optionally updated, then completed.

oneOf.description: The lockfile on disk is up-to-date after the operation.
The lockfile on disk is missing or needs changes.
